上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科 - CS6。/ 第7巡捕房
报告
档案号 7
日期 1937年7月11日。

事由 沃尔特·莱曼（Walter LEHMANN），德国人。

撰写人及呈送人：D.S. 皮茨（Pitts）。

鉴于此前关于德国人沃尔特·莱曼（Walter LEHMANN）的报告内容及其上的批注，本人须陈述，此人于1937年6月18日离开新亚大酒店前往南京，并于6月21日返回此处，再次入住同一家酒店。6月26日，他前往青岛和北平，试图出售其画作。目前未发现有关此人活动的其他负面情况。

J.A. 皮茨（Pitts）。
副督察（D. S.）

助理警司（特务科远东处）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch - C.S.D. Station,
REPORT
Date June 15, 1937.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S.B.D. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. / Station, / Date June 15, 1937.）

Subject Walter LEHMANN, German.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by （手写签名）

On June 12, 1937 a young German named Walter
LEHMANN visited Police Headquarters and endeavoured to
sell a number of water colour paintings to members of
the Headquarters staff. These paintings he claimed
were his own work. He stated that he was making a
study-trip around the world and was trying to cover his
travelling expenses by selling his work. He was in
possession of a letter signed by the Commissioner of
Police authorising him to visit the various offices in
this building in order to display his wares.

It has since been learned from the French Police
and the German Consulate General that LEHMANN claims to
be the son of the German Ambassador in Egypt. In fact,
however, no such dignitary exists. He is looked upon
with suspicion by the German authorities here, who have
received bad reports concerning his activities from
a number of consular representatives in the Far East.

Attached herewith is a translation of a letter
from the French Ambassador in China addressed to the
French Consul General in Shanghai, which is self explanatory.

LEHMANN has been residing at Room 303, New Asia
Hotel, North Szechuen Road since June 8, 1937 and is
contemplating proceeding to Nanking and Peiping in the
next few days.

LEHMANN has been interviewed and he states that he
has never claimed that he was the son of any German official,
and although he did have some money difficulties in Indo-
China, he has endeavoured, and is still endeavouring to
settle up his debts. He seems to be quite frank in his

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科 - C.S.D. 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1937年6月15日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特务科登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. / 巡捕房，/ 日期 1937年6月15日。）

事由 沃尔特·莱曼（Walter LEHMANN），德国人。

撰写人 D.S. 皮茨（Pitts）。呈送人 （手写签名）

1937年6月12日，一名名叫沃尔特·莱曼（Walter LEHMANN）的年轻德国人访问了警察总局，并试图向总局职员出售数幅水彩画。他声称这些画作是其本人作品。他表示自己正在进行环球考察旅行，并试图通过出售作品来支付旅费。他持有一封由警务处处长签署的信函，授权他在本大楼内的各个办公室展示其商品。

此后从法国警方和德国总领事馆获悉，莱曼自称是德国驻埃及大使的儿子。然而事实上，并无此位高权重之人。他在沪的德国当局眼中备受怀疑，德国当局已收到来自远东多位领事代表关于其活动的不良报告。

随函附上中国驻法国大使致上海法国总领事的信件译文，该信内容不言自明。

自1937年6月8日以来，莱曼一直居住在四川北路新亚大酒店303室，并计划在未来几天内前往南京和北平。

经讯问，莱曼表示他从未声称自己是任何德国官员的儿子，尽管他在印度支那确实遇到了一些资金困难，但他一直努力且仍在努力清偿债务。他在言行举止上似乎相当坦率，并

TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNICATION IN FRENCH DATED MAY 31, 1937

French Embassy in China,
No. 92 N.                                Nanking, May 31, 1937.

MONSIEUR P.E. NAGGIAR, Ambassador in China
to
THE FRENCH CONSUL GENERAL IN SHANGHAI.

I think you should be warned against a
German of the name of WALTER LEHMANN, who
left Indo-China on May 20 for China, without
paying the charges on a car that he had hired
in Saigon and without meeting his hotel bill
at the Hotel Metropole in Hanoi.

This individual who claims to be the son
of the German Ambassador in Egypt and who
states that he is an artist and painter, has
only sold pictures which he purchased from
Annamite artists at prices from one to three
piastres, and to which he signs his name.

Signed: NAGGIAR.

1937年5月31日法文来函译文

法国驻华大使馆，
编号 92 N.                                南京，1937年5月31日。

中国驻法国大使 P.E. 纳吉亚尔（NAGGIAR）先生
致
上海法国总领事。

我认为应当提醒你们提防一名名叫沃尔特·莱曼（WALTER LEHMANN）的德国人，他于5月20日离开印度支那前往中国，未支付其在西贡租用汽车的费用，也未结清其在河内大都会酒店（Hotel Metropole）的住宿账单。

此人自称是德国驻埃及大使的儿子，并称自己是一名艺术家和画家，但他出售的画作仅是以一至三皮阿斯特（piastres）的价格从安南艺术家处购买，并签上自己的名字。

签名：纳吉亚尔（NAGGIAR）。
